attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the provided ed25519 public key for SSH access, locked its local password, and confirmed/enforced sshd-wide key-based authentication (PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1 natively, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified sshd and the opsadmin configuration recovered intact post-restart.
